info.name: Kubernetes Services List Services across all namespaces

params.name: labelSelector
params.description: Label selector expression to filter resources. Supports equality (=, ==, !=) and set-based (in, notin, exists) operators.

params.name: fieldSelector
params.description: Field selector expression to filter resources by field values. Example: metadata.name=my-service

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of items to return. Use with continue for pagination.

params.name: watch
params.description: If true, return a watch stream of changes instead of a list.

items.docs: Returns a list of all Services across every namespace in the cluster. Useful for cluster-wide service discovery and auditing. Supports label and field filtering.
